before.name: Source-specific Type-S/Type-H weak multiscale BvM under only the prior, cutoff, and truth assumptions
before.reason: The source states this theorem, but its proof invokes prior-specific sup-norm contraction, a low-frequency Gaussian coefficient bound, and finite-dimensional semiparametric BvM results; the Type-H prior-change calculation is expressly omitted in the cited proof. These verifications are not supplied by the current BCS-08 or BCS-16 bodies.

after.name: Source-specific Type-S weak multiscale BvM under the approved prior, cutoff and truth assumptions
after.reason: Complete local proof uses quotient likelihood coercivity, direct wavelet composition and commutator estimates, posterior directional Laplace bounds, fixed-projection Gaussian limits and posterior multiscale tails. Arbitrary globally log-Lipschitz S1 and the approved Gaussian S2 range alpha>1/2 are retained; no external contraction or semiparametric BvM theorem substitutes for a local proof.

rows.reason: The conjugate Dirichlet/Gamma proof gives finite-projection limits, one common normalization event and multiscale posterior tails, avoiding the omitted external prior-shift argument.

rows.name: Continuous strictly increasing density-bridge norm distributions and positive interior quantiles
rows.reason: Closed linear Gaussian support, attained coefficient maxima and Brownian-bridge reflection prove both actual norm-quantile premises.

rows.name: Actual Type-S and Type-H CDF and multiscale credible-band calibration
rows.reason: The local corollary verifies posterior BvM, sampling-center CLT, positive norm-quantile regularity and the additional primitive-map summability; diameter retains its separate smoothness/undersmoothing hypotheses.

before.name: Theorem 2 and Lemma 4: Type-S log-density sup-norm contraction from an assumed Hellinger rate plus prior-specific conditions
before.reason: The source result requires the stated Hellinger contraction premise and its own prior conditions. The current IID posterior-contraction supplier has not been checked against those Type-S assumptions, and the local multiscale BvM proof does not establish this contraction result.

after.name: Type-S sup-norm contraction needed at the BCS-17 cutoffs: local replacement for the contraction import in Theorem 2 and Lemma 4
after.reason: The precise local sharp rate a_n=sqrt(dim(V_L) max(L,1)/n) is proved in steps 2.1–2.3 of the Type-S theorem, from the separately proved preliminary quotient contraction and projection commutator. This records that source-specific local contraction only; it does not claim to reproduce the external theorem in every model satisfying its assumed Hellinger and prior conditions.

before.reason: These source calculations are needed to establish the high-probability Type-H BvM event; they have not been fully reconstructed as local items, so they are recorded as an explicit proof obligation.

after.reason: No such counterexample is supplied by the cited source theorem statements or the inspected relevant proof passages. source_evidence_policy: Every existing source object, URL, locator, recovery_attempts and fetch_verified object remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Operations replace or append content disposition rows only; every replaced before row is preserved verbatim here and the complete original coverage file is archived. No new reading/fetch/verification claims are stamped.
review_scope: Compare existing coverage metadata with already accepted frozen local source proofs and approved example wording only; no new mathematical audit, repair cycle, source proof edit, optional test or gate.
authority: Root alone applies guarded live coverage operations and owner acceptance.
